```{r}
# check that scraping is allowed (Step 0)
robotstxt::paths_allowed("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pikachu")

session <- bow(
  "https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pikachu", force = TRUE
)

poke_name <- scrape(session) |>
  html_nodes(".JsonViewer-module__json--2OTYy > ul > li > ul > li:nth-child(2) label+ span") |>
  html_text()
poke_name
```



```{r}
#| eval: FALSE

# Create a vector of 5 movie names you want to study
#  - must figure out pattern in URL for obtaining different movies

api_key <- "pokemon?limit="

# Set up empty tibble
pkmn <- tibble(
  Name = character(), 
  Height = double(), 
  Weight = double(),
  Type = character(), 
  Abilities = character(), 
  Stats = character()
)

# Use for loop to run through API request process 5 times,
#   each time filling the next row in the tibble
#  - can do max of 1000 GETs per day
for(i in 1:10) {
  url <- str_c("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/", api_key, i)
  Sys.sleep(0.5)
  onepkmn <- GET(url)
  details <- content(onepkmn, "parse")
  pkmn[i,1] <- details$name
  pkmn[i,2] <- details$height  
  pkmn[i,3] <- details$weight  # genres (single string - could be more than one)
  pkmn[i,4] <- details$type  # actors (single string - could be more than one)
  pkmn[i,5] <- details$abilities  # metascore (be sure it is numeric)
  pkmn[i,6] <- Stats  # imdb rating (be sure it is numeric)
}

pkmn
```


```{r}
pokemon_data <- tibble(
  name = character(1351),
  height = numeric(1351),
  weight = numeric(1351),
  type1 = character(1351),
  type2 = character(1351),
  abilities = character(1351),
  hp = numeric(1351),
  atk = numeric(1351),
  def = numeric(1351),
  spatk = numeric(1351),
  spdef = numeric(1351),
  spd = numeric(1351)
)

for (i in 1:10) {

  url <- str_c("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/", i)

  pokemon_response <- GET(url)
  details <- content(pokemon_response, "parse")

  pokemon_data$name[i] <- details$name
  pokemon_data$height[i] <- details$height
  pokemon_data$weight[i] <- details$weight
  pokemon_data$type1[i] <- details$types[[1]][[2]]
  pokemon_data$type2[i] <- details$types[[2]][[2]]
  pokemon_data$abilities[i] <- details$abilities
  pokemon_data$hp[i] <- details$stats[[1]]
  pokemon_data$atk[i] <- details$stats[[2]]
  pokemon_data$def[i] <- details$stats[[3]]
  pokemon_data$spatk[i] <- details$stats[[4]]
  pokemon_data$spdef[i] <- details$stats[[5]]
  pokemon_data$spd[i] <- details$stats[[6]]
}

pokemon_data
```
